title: WPSS/504/2019 of SHIVA NEGI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (S/S) No. 504 of 2019
Shiva Negi Ö Petitioner
Vs
State of Uttarakhand & another Ö Respondents
Mr. Nalin Saun, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Mr. Sushil Vashisth, learned Brief Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, learned counsel for respondent No. 2.
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
1. Petitioner participated in a selection for the post of
Khanij Moharrir held by Uttarakhand Technical Education
Board. According to him, he was selected and was called for
document verification by the Selecting Body vide
communication dated 11.01.2019. Since the Selecting Body
did not recommend the name of the petitioner, therefore, he
has approached this Court.
2. It has come on record that the minimum educational
qualification required for the post of Khanij Moharrir is
Intermediate, as per Rule 8 of the applicable service rules.
Admittedly petitioner does not possess Intermediate
qualification; however, he possesses Diploma in Electronics
Engineering with B.Tech degree in Electronics &
Communications Engineering. Thus, according to the
petitioner, he possessed much higher qualification than
Intermediate (12th standard), therefore, his candidature cannot
be rejected on the ground that he does not possess
Intermediate qualification.
3. Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the
claim of the petitioner, this Court finds that ends of justice
would be met if the petitioner is permitted to make a
representation to the Competent Authority i.e. Director,
Geology & Mining Unit, Directorate of Industries, Dehradun
(respondent No. 1 herein).

2
4. Accordingly, writ petition is disposed with liberty to
the petitioner to make a representation to respondent No. 1,
within two weeks from today. If such a representation is made,
respondent No. 1 shall consider the same and take appropriate
decision, in accordance with law, within ten weeks from the
date of receipt of such representation along with certified copy
of this order.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
19.03.2019
Aswal
